description: Execute a preview from preview_order: re-checked at a fresh price, then sent to the exchange with its stop-loss placed there. Use only after a successful preview. Not for new or changed orders (preview again). If a person must approve (propose level, or no trade:execute scope) it waits; wait_seconds (0-30) holds the call open for the decision. Inputs: preview_id, client_order_id (idempotency key: repeating it returns the first result). A fill cannot be undone; the remedy is close_position. Next: get_order_status(request_id) while pending.

client_order_id.description: Your idempotency key, unique per agent; repeating it returns the first result instead of a second order

wait_seconds.description: If the order needs a person's approval, wait up to this long for the decision before returning

name: execute_previewed_order

current.description: The order's value for this rule

asset.description: The asset it was charged in (USDT, USDC, BNB …)

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

estimated_usd.description: The account's rate x the filled notional, USD

status.description: pending (not read yet), done, or unknown (the exchange never showed it)

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

size_base.description: Closes this much when triggered, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD

approval_expires_at.description: While pending: when the approval request lapses, ISO 8601 UTC

cancelled.description: cancel_order with all_waiting_entries: the order ids withdrawn (venue ids and req_… trigger entries); [] when nothing was waiting

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

error.description: Why it was rejected or failed

fee.description: Once executed: the trading fee, estimated at once and replaced by the amount the exchange charged once its fill records show it

filled_size.description: Filled size, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD

legs.description: A ladder entry: per leg {price, size_base, order_id, sl_oid, status}; status resting, or after a refused leg withdrawn, filled or partly_filled

order_id.description: Venue order id of the fill

receipt.description: Signed receipt (compact JWS, EdDSA) once executed: request, checks, preview price, fill, slippage, order ids, delegation. Verify with /.well-known/tradehub-receipts.jwks

sl_oid.description: Venue order id of the protective stop

trigger_price.description: status armed: opens at market when the mark reaches this, USD per coin
